When someone asks "where does your 53-artefact model come from?", this is the answer — and it also tells you what to hand over. Sending the classification reference alongside the case lets a client verify the structure independently rather than taking the tool's word for it.

A number in this app is only as good as its tier. Benchmarks are defensible in a room; engineering estimates need to be replaced by the client's own measurements during 🤝 Engage before they carry weight.
body: Traceability: the model relies on the AgentCase_Classification_V2 reference and public benchmarks.

53 classified SDLC artifacts (value, skill, irreducible human supervision) · 11 V-cycle phases · 9 industries with standards (DO-178C, ISO 26262, IEC 62304, MDR, DORA, SecNumCloud…) · skills catalogue (existing/agentic/regulatory) · 13 grades · 7 locations (Local/Nearshore/Offshore).
The Rate Card day rates and the regulatory glass ceiling are assumptions to confirm with the client's finance and compliance teams before any binding use.
